notes.title: New stories, new bonds, new friends 🐱👴🏻
notes.content:
Introducing Playstark’s last project [b]"The Old Man and His Cat"[/b] – A beautiful story about a stray cat helping a lonely old man find happiness again.

[h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43995652/c05fb9ce577e7aaa5b86cb6f863e30c82ccf8984.gif[/img][/h1]

The game follows the story of Domino, a stray cat meeting a lonely old man, and thanks to his kindness, decides to help him to achieve happiness again after the passing away of his lovely wife. 

The game is aimed to be a calm experience, encouraging players to take their time to explore the beautiful environments, interact with the world around them, solve puzzles and discover a small but charming story told through its gameplay and visuals.

Our dev team is gearing up to share the progress updates on our social media channels. Stay tuned for a sneak peek into our development process!

✨🐱 So don't miss out on the latest updates - Add our game to your [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2343660/The_old_man_and_his_cat/]Wishlist[/url][/b] and follow us on [b][url=https://twitter.com/PlaystarkGames]Twitter[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://www.instagram.com/playstarkgames/]Instagram[/url][/b]! 👴🏻✨
